> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).

## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 35. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames Moore as a coach on the fast track: his time at Boise State crossed over with brother Kellen, who has a slightly more high-profile job, and while the 35-year-old isn't coaching the Saints like his 37-year-old brother, three years of calling plays at Missouri and one at Fresno State now has him in a head coaching role. He rates the pedigree — grabbing a branch of the Chris Petersen, Kalen DeBoer, Eli Drinkwitz coaching tree is far from a bad idea — then states the constraint: he's going to need to grow into the role with a programme that hasn't really been investing in its roster while being a Pac-12 orphan with Mountain West guardianship. His conclusion is about timing: now back in the Pac-12, the programme will invest in the head coach and the roster all at once, and that will probably take some time.
